name: Mike DelGuidice and the Cans Band
reviewNotes:
Added automatically from Live On The Porch (Smithtown) - show calendar. Check the name and add a website or social page.

Directory research 2026-10-04: The 'Cans Band' has no website or social pages of its own that I could find; the venue links Mike DelGuidice's official site, so the links recorded here are Mike's own official pages (from mikedelguidice.com). The booking phone/email belong to his management company, Miracle Concerts, as published on his bookings page. There is a separate 'mike-delguidice' performer in the inventory (Mulcahy's); the owner may want to link or merge them. Logo is Mike's white wordmark (transparent PNG; needs a dark background). Photo shows Mike alone and has 'MIKE DELGUIDICE' printed along the bottom; the 50% 25% focus keeps the text mostly out of a 16:9 crop. Skipped two other site photos because they carry photographer watermarks. Note: Live On The Porch is Mike DelGuidice's own venue.
description: A classic rock and yacht rock cover show where Long Island singer Mike DelGuidice (of Billy Joel's touring band) plays drums with the Cans Band. The set list covers the Beatles, Eagles, Pink Floyd, U2, Journey, Christopher Cross and more.
